causal_feature_contract.bucket_availability: A bucket becomes actionable only at its right boundary; quote and OI states are received strictly before that boundary.
causal_feature_contract.bucket_vwap: sum(price*amount)/sum(amount) over completed trades by local_timestamp; use the last causal mid only when no completed trade VWAP exists.
causal_feature_contract.calendar_decay: Each map decays once every five-second bucket even through a temporarily unavailable BBO.
causal_feature_contract.closing_attribution: For negative OI delta, sell aggression removes inferred long cohorts and buy aggression removes inferred short cohorts pro rata.
causal_feature_contract.oi_delta: Finite raw relative change between the latest OI received strictly before consecutive bucket boundaries; no outcome-dependent clipping.
causal_feature_contract.opening_attribution: For positive OI delta, add abs(delta)*abs(flow purity) to inferred long cohorts when flow is positive and short cohorts when flow is negative.
causal_feature_contract.pressure_quantile_basis: All finite positive fit pressure states by symbol, map and direction.
causal_feature_contract.prior_realized_scale: Square root of the sum of the previous 180 completed five-second squared log returns, shifted one bucket, minimum 60 observations, floored by two causal spreads.

conditional_next_stage.one_or_more_survivors: Freeze survivors, test every remaining pre-2024 first-day sample, then implement structural state exits, funding, risk sizing and continuous NAV before any sequential 2024 opening.
conditional_next_stage.zero_survivors: Retire this exact inventory-map dependency and keep 2024-2026 sealed.

data_contract.integrity: Every downloaded gzip must match the frozen byte count and SHA-256 before parsing.
data_contract.later_periods: 2024-2026 are code- and workflow-prohibited in this stage.
data_contract.market: USDT linear perpetual public normalized data

economic_mechanism.cascade_followthrough: Price crosses the previously mapped band while open interest contracts and aggression remains aligned, indicating forced inventory release.
economic_mechanism.cluster_attraction: Aligned displacement and aggressive flow approach a dense un-crossed vulnerable-inventory band.
economic_mechanism.depletion_reversal: After a crossed band loses at least half of its mapped pressure and price/flow reclaim the opposite side, trade away from the exhausted pool.
economic_mechanism.inventory_stock: Positive open-interest change is assigned to the dominant aggressor side at the completed bucket VWAP; negative open-interest change removes the dominant closing side pro rata from all surviving cohorts. Cohorts decay in calendar time.
economic_mechanism.liquidity_pool: Each surviving short cohort projects an upside stop/liquidation-hazard band and each surviving long cohort projects a downside band using only prior realized volatility and the causal spread. Local kernel density is the quantitative pool pressure.
economic_mechanism.smc_ict_translation: The pool is not a later-confirmed swing. It is a contemporaneous estimate of trapped outstanding inventory; displacement, liquidity run and reclaim are separately timestamped causal states.

execution_and_cost_contract.entry: First executable BBO observed at or after the completed decision boundary plus latency; long buys ask and short sells bid.
execution_and_cost_contract.exit: First executable BBO at or after entry quote time plus the diagnostic horizon; long sells bid and short buys ask.
execution_and_cost_contract.funding: Deferred because this fatal screen uses only 30-300 second diagnostic markouts; any survivor must add exact funding before rank eligibility.
execution_and_cost_contract.global_slot: One accepted event across BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT. Same-boundary ties choose the largest pressure-to-fit-threshold score, then deterministic symbol order. Exact exit-timestamp re-entry is prohibited.
execution_and_cost_contract.observed_spread: Embedded in executable entry and exit quotes.
execution_and_cost_contract.qualification: Elapsed-time markouts are diagnostic and cannot be ranked or deployed. A survivor must replace them with state-transition exits and continuous NAV replay.

frozen_grid.dimensions: 18 maps x 2 pressure quantiles x 2 flow floors x 3 families x 2 latencies x 3 horizons

implementation.performance_note: Signal arrays are cached within each map only; each latency/horizon replays its own causal executable quotes and global slot.

matched_baseline_contract.fallback: Use matched cell with at least 5 fit events; otherwise symbol baseline with at least 10 fit events; otherwise global fit baseline.
matched_baseline_contract.matching: Each selected development trade is matched by symbol, fit-only low/high realized-volatility bucket and fixed distance bucket <=0.75 sigma, (0.75,1.50] sigma or >1.50 sigma.
matched_baseline_contract.source: Fit outcomes only from the identical map, family, flow floor, latency and horizon without the high-pressure threshold.

non_overlap: Not adjacent tuning of PR #74 instantaneous 1/2/5-second OI-change, flow-efficiency and fixed-barrier policies.

Not cross-venue OI breadth, wallet identity, public liquidation labels, L2 cancellation/refill, passive queues, event-tape pace, metaorder cadence, cross-venue price lag, options, premium, clock seasonality or completed-bar momentum.
objective: Test whether a causal stock of still-open long/short cohorts by inferred entry price creates a repeatable vulnerable-inventory pressure map whose attraction, forced-closure crossing or depletion-reclaim state leaves executable residual markout after realistic spread and additional cost stress.
prohibitions: No 2024-2026 source access in this workflow.
No parameter, attribution, closure, threshold, latency, cost, horizon or gate change after development outcomes are read.
No stale or favorable missing-price fill.
No live credentials, paper orders, testnet orders or live orders.
No project-wide ranking promotion from this sparse diagnostic screen.
